character.name: Tansy Moulder
character.background: Cleric of the Grave, Plague Survivor

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.description: You point at a creature within 60ft, and a spectral funeral bell tolls. The target must make a WIS save or take 1d12 necrotic damage; it takes extra damage if it is missing any HP.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: You create a minor supernatural effect within 30ft: flickering lights, unearthly creaks, distant whispers, or other eerie phenomena. You use this to spook superstitious villagers or lighten the mood with dark jokes about the afterlife.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: Touch a creature to restore 1d8 + 3 HP. The lingering warmth of your infected blood steadies the sick, though you pull away the second they stir, terrified of passing the Pox on.

spells.name: False Life
spells.description: You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary HP for 1 hour, drawn from the faint, corrupted vitality of the plague lingering in your veins. Your skin takes on a sallow, waxy sheen while the spell lasts.

traits: Plague Carrier: The Red Pox lives in your blood, asymptomatic but slowly contagious to the unexposed. You cannot feel its presence, only the weight of the lives it may have taken.
Gallows Humor: You cope with endless death by making crass, morbid jokes about rot and decay, often unsettling the healthy villagers you encounter.
Tender to the Sick: You cannot turn away anyone who is ill, dropping everything to tend to them even when it risks exposing them to your infection.
Mysophobia: You are terrified of touching or being close to the healthy, convinced your blood will curse them with the same plague that destroyed your home.
character.gear: Iron mace · Leather plague coat · Wooden shield painted with a red cross · Priest's pack · 3 vials of aromatic balm · Tattered blight map · Silver skull holy symbol
character.story: The Red Pox took every soul in my halfling hollow when I was ten. I should have died with them, but the sickness curled in my blood like a sleepy cat, never enough to fell me. I tended the dying as the village burned, buried my family with my own hands, and set out to find the cure the priest spoke of in his last breaths. I make jokes about the rot to keep from screaming. I don't know why I lived. I only know the sick need me, and the healthy run from my touch. The bell tolls for all of us.

inventory.name: Iron Mace
inventory.lore: A simple iron mace blessed by your village's priest before the plague swept through. You've used it to put down the reanimated corpses of plague victims who rose from their graves, unworthy of a proper burial.
inventory.description: A dented iron mace with a worn leather grip, stained with old blood.

inventory.name: Leather Plague Coat
inventory.lore: Tanned and waxed by your village's last leatherworker before they fell to the Red Pox, treated with aromatic herbs to mask the scent of infection. It still holds the faint, coppery smell of old blood.
inventory.description: A heavy, waxed leather coat with a high collar and a beak-like mask attached to the hood, stained with dark spots.
inventory.effects: Advantage on saves to resist inhaled diseases or miasmas.

inventory.name: Wooden Shield (Red Cross)
inventory.lore: Painted by you with the red cross of the healers, the wood is stained with the blood of the plague victims you tried to save. The cross has started to peel at the edges, as if the wood itself is rotting.
inventory.description: A round wooden shield painted with a faded red cross, strapped to your forearm.

inventory.name: Priest's Pack
inventory.lore: The canvas pack your village priest carried, filled with herbs, bandages, and ritual components. You've added a small vial of grave dirt from the village cemetery to the front pouch, a token of your devotion to the Grave domain.
inventory.description: A sturdy canvas pack with leather straps, containing bandages, holy water, and ritual components.

inventory.name: Aromatic Balm Vial
inventory.lore: A thick, pungent balm made of rosemary, mint, and crushed grave moss, used to mask the scent of rot and infection. You rub it under your mask before entering a village, though you're not sure if it actually works.
inventory.description: Small glass vials of green, waxy balm with a sharp, herbal smell.
inventory.effects: Masks the scent of infection and rot for 1 hour per application. Grants advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when interacting with people who are not yet suspicious of you.

inventory.name: Tattered Blight Map
inventory.lore: A map of the surrounding countryside, marked with Xs where plague villages once stood. The edges are stained with mildew and old blood, and the ink is fading in the areas where the plague has spread most recently.
inventory.description: A torn parchment map of the region, marked with Xs over plague hotspots and dotted with notes about safe wells and abandoned villages.
inventory.effects: Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to navigate blighted or plague-ridden terrain.

inventory.name: Silver Skull Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: Carved from a piece of silver your mother hid in the walls of your home before the plague took her. The skull's eye sockets are set with tiny garnets, and it hums faintly when you are near a grave or a dying person.
inventory.description: A small, intricately carved silver skull, warm to the touch, with garnet eyes that glint in low light.
inventory.effects: Can be used as a spellcasting focus for all Grave Domain spells. Once per day, you can activate it to cast spare the dying without expending a spell slot.

inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
